integrity: Equilibria, conjugacy, generator identities, equality classification, and the baseline residual were reconstructed from the printed vector field and replayed by the bundled exact symbolic checker.
scientific_limitations: The invariant-measure law is proved only for compactly supported invariant probability measures and does not establish existence of non-equilibrium recurrent measures.
No claim is made about the correctness of published Lyapunov spectra, attractor numerics, encryption performance, or global boundedness.
Literature and semantic-database searches reduce but cannot eliminate the risk of an unindexed prior statement of the same correction or balance law.
title: Exact equilibria and a sharp stationary recurrence barrier in a four-dimensional hyperchaotic flow
